definitions.full: H943. buk בּוּךְ verb perplex, confuse (? Arabic stir up (water of spring) then be disturbed, confused ; compare Assyrian bâku , lead captive , originally lead astray ? COT Ezra 4:2 ) — only Niph`al Perfect 3feminine singular נָב֫וֺכָה Est 3:15 ; 3 masculine plural נָבֹ֫כוּ Joel 1:18 ; Participle plural נְבֻכִים Exod 14:3 ; — be confused, in confusion (of a city) Est 3:15 ; = wander aimlessly (of Israel) Exod 14:3 ; so of cattle Joel 1:18 (Merx proposes בָּכוּ , after ᵐ5 ἔκλαυσαν , but בכה not elsewhere of cattle).

occurrences.englishText: Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, ‘They are entangled in the land. The wilderness has shut them in.’
The couriers went out in haste by the king’s commandment, and the decree was given out in the citadel of Susa. The king and Haman sat down to drink; but the city of Susa was perplexed.
